scope: Accepted sourced price records. Overall spans may cross formats, retailers, markets and price bases; they are not a comparable return series. Comparable single-series spans retain variant, seller, currency, country, retail-versus-wholesale level and known tax basis and exclude MSRP or unknown basis. Month-only dates remain YYYY-MM. Elapsed spans use conservative month bounds: earliest possible evidence may occur at month end and latest at month start; those internal bounds are never stored as source observation days. Missing years are not interpolated. Document/launch dates keep their stated scope in source notes.
